item: The launcher removes the stderr pid file of a launcher that is no longer running at the next launch
summary: A launcher killed outright left .launcher_stderr.<pid>.pid until the day-old rule cleared it. Each launch now removes the files named for a pid that does not run (tested through /proc where it exists, kill -0 elsewhere), keeps its own, any live launcher's and any file whose recorded server pid still runs (a launcher killed outright can leave its server and stderr filter running, and the filter reads the file), and leaves a name that is not a pid to the day-old rule. A pid reused by another process keeps its file until the day-old rule: a stated limit, not an error. Closes the named open item from the independent read.
